config.autowindowsize.meta.configVersion: Internal config version for automatic migration. Do not modify manually.
config.autowindowsize.startup.applyStart: For modpack authors: one-time first-launch guide that automatically applies fullscreen/maximize on first launch, then resets to false.
config.autowindowsize.startup.autoBorder: Whether to automatically enable borderless mode on next launch. Not mutually exclusive with auto fullscreen/maximize.
config.autowindowsize.startup.autoFullsc: Automatically enter fullscreen on next launch (set in-game). Mutually exclusive with auto maximize.
config.autowindowsize.startup.autoMaximi: Automatically maximize window on next launch (set in-game). Mutually exclusive with auto fullscreen.
config.autowindowsize.startup.startFulls: Only effective when one-time first launch guide is enabled: auto fullscreen on first launch. Mutually exclusive with first launch auto maximize.
config.autowindowsize.startup.startMaxim: Only effective when one-time first launch guide is enabled: auto maximize on first launch. Mutually exclusive with first launch auto fullscreen.
config.autowindowsize.startup.startupDel: Seconds to wait after launch before applying window size, avoids stretching the loading screen.
When enabled, the window has no title bar or borders. Auto borderless in fullscreen. Borderless windows cannot be dragged by title bar.
config.autowindowsize.window.debug.toolt: When enabled, outputs detailed preset availability checks and other diagnostic info to logs. For troubleshooting. Can be toggled in-game or with /aws debug. Default off.
config.autowindowsize.window.height.tool: Window height at launch, also the minimum for size lock.
config.autowindowsize.window.rememberPos: Remember window position, size and state on exit, restore on next launch instead of forcing center.
config.autowindowsize.window.width.toolt: Window width at launch, also the minimum for size lock.
gui.autowindowsize.about.title: About Auto Window Size
gui.autowindowsize.about.tooltip: View mod details, core features, usage, download channels, feedback and author info.
gui.autowindowsize.aspect.center_tooltip: Shows current selected ratio and real-time window resolution; click left/right arrows to switch ratio, presets below will update accordingly
gui.autowindowsize.autoborderless.toolti: Automatically enable borderless mode on next launch. Not mutually exclusive with auto fullscreen/maximize.
gui.autowindowsize.autofs.tooltip: Automatically enter fullscreen on next launch. Mutually exclusive with auto maximize, this button auto-disables when auto maximize is selected.
gui.autowindowsize.automax.tooltip: Automatically maximize window on next launch. Mutually exclusive with auto fullscreen, this button auto-disables when auto fullscreen is selected.
gui.autowindowsize.borderless.tooltip:
Removes title bar and borders when enabled.
Three borderless effects with window state:
· Borderless windowed: keeps current size
· Borderless maximized: fills screen work area
· Borderless fullscreen: fills entire screen
gui.autowindowsize.center.tooltip: Center the window on its current monitor with one click. Unavailable in fullscreen, maximized, minimized or already centered.
gui.autowindowsize.config.title: Auto Window Size
gui.autowindowsize.config_abnormal: Config Status: Abnormal  Min Size Lock Disabled
gui.autowindowsize.custom_lock_hint: Tip: Disable min size lock to unlock more preset resolution buttons
gui.autowindowsize.debug.tooltip: When enabled, outputs detailed preset disable checks and other info to logs for troubleshooting.
gui.autowindowsize.detail_borderless_ful: Some features paused in borderless fullscreen, auto-restore on exit
gui.autowindowsize.detail_borderless_max: Some features paused in borderless maximized, auto-restore on cancel
gui.autowindowsize.detail_dragging: Resizing window, confirm after releasing mouse
gui.autowindowsize.detail_error: Config resolution exceeds screen, min size lock disabled
gui.autowindowsize.detail_fixed: Window size locked, cannot drag edges to resize
gui.autowindowsize.detail_fullscreen: Some features paused in fullscreen, auto-restore on exit
gui.autowindowsize.detail_maximized: Some features paused when maximized, auto-restore on cancel
gui.autowindowsize.detail_normal: All features available, window can be freely resized
gui.autowindowsize.disabled_reason: ⚠ Config resolution exceeds screen, lock disabled
gui.autowindowsize.fixed.tooltip: Locks current window size, cannot be resized by dragging edges. OS-level maximize also disabled. Unavailable in fullscreen or maximized.
gui.autowindowsize.lock.tooltip:
When enabled, window can only be enlarged, not shrunk below config size (min 856×482).
Restores pre-fullscreen state when exiting fullscreen.
Preset buttons below may be disabled in fullscreen/maximized, when exceeding screen resolution, or when below config/min value while lock is on.
gui.autowindowsize.preset.tooltip:
Click to apply this resolution and center the window.
May be disabled when:
· In fullscreen or maximized
· Exceeds current screen resolution
· Below config value or min (856×482) when lock is on
· Already equals current window resolution
gui.autowindowsize.remember.tooltip: Remembers window size and position before exiting game, restores them on next launch instead of forcing center.
gui.autowindowsize.top.tooltip:
Window always-on-top mode:
· Off: normal window
· Normal: standard always-on-top
· Force: always stays above other same-level topmost windows, but not above system-level topmost windows (e.g. Task Manager)
gui.autowindowsize.window_status_draggin: Window State: Resizing  Refresh after release
gui.autowindowsize.window_status_fixed: Window State: Fixed Size  Cannot resize
gui.autowindowsize.window_status_fullscr: Window State: Fullscreen  Some features unavailable
gui.autowindowsize.window_status_maximiz: Window State: Maximized  Some features unavailable
gui.autowindowsize.window_status_normal: Window State: Normal  All features available
gui.autowindowsize.windowstate.tooltip: Cycle window state: Windowed → Maximized → Fullscreen. Works in borderless mode too.
